viewing_check: Photograph the signature up close (full forename, any date), the back of the canvas and board backing for labels, titles, dealer or exhibition stickers, the stretcher and canvas type, any restoration under UV if possible, and the German text on the plaque for any title. Measure the size and check frame condition and paint losses.
